busy: The Library is busy. Try again in a moment.
diskFull: Disk full. Free up some space and try again.
cannotWrite: Can't save to the app's data folder (it may be read-only). Restart the app.
damaged: The Library's database is damaged. Restart the app.
database: Couldn't read or save the Library. Try again.
stopped: The Library has stopped. Restart the app.
internal: Something went wrong. Try again or restart the app.
